mentions.name: Photos Wallpaper
mentions.description: A macOS app that rotates photos from the user's photo library as the desktop wallpaper, changing them on a schedule — recreating functionality that existed in older Mac OS versions. It was accepted onto the Mac App Store.
mentions.problem: Newer Mac OS versions dropped the older built-in ability to rotate photos from your library as wallpaper on a schedule.
mentions.source_excerpt: Photos Wallpaper - recreates the functionality from older Mac OS versions to rotate photos from your library as wallpaper, changing on a schedule.
